purpose: D1GA application-guard canary on larger repeat-02 delta cases before any wider guarded-lane run.
selection_rules: Use only larger repeat-02 cases where D0 and D1G differed.
Compare the new D1GA guarded lane against cached D0/D1G artifacts.
Do not inspect related hidden patches, hidden tests, final answers, or grading results when creating prompts.

pairs.expected_reusable_decision: When trimming trailing punctuation after HTML unescaping, compute the punctuation count in the unescaped text and slice that many original characters from the end; do not mix escaped and unescaped lengths.
pairs.d1_applicability_reason: The related issue is another urlize trailing-punctuation trimming failure.

pairs.expected_reusable_decision: For unittest --pdb teardown suppression, treat both method-level and class-level unittest skips as skipped before replacing tearDown.
pairs.d1_applicability_reason: The related issue is another skipped unittest teardown path.

pairs.expected_reusable_decision: When composing CREATE INDEX column SQL, append suffixes and opclasses with explicit spaces only when the suffix text is non-empty; never concatenate order/opclass fragments directly to quoted column names.
pairs.d1_applicability_reason: The related issue is in the same CREATE INDEX SQL fragment composition behavior.
